label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input (param from request.getParameter) flows directly to host variable, then to connectHttpByHostname(host) sink at L44. The URL construction http://+host opens a network connection to attacker-controlled destination. Critical SSRF weakness: DNS resolution (resolveHost) and actual fetch (connectHttpByHostname) are separated by Thread.sleep(50) and potential DNS record changes between validation and connection. The isNonPublicAddress check validates the resolved IP at resolution time, but the actual connection uses the potentially-changed DNS record afterward. Resolved sink value: http://{user_input}/api connects to attacker-specified host.

evidence.note: User param flows to host, then connectHttpByHostname(host) constructs URL with user input and opens connection
resolveHost performs DNS lookup separately from the actual fetch in connectHttpByHostname
